entities.summary: Sir Alan Charles MacLaurin Mackerras (; was an American-born Australian conductor. He was an authority on the operas of Janáček and Mozart, and the comic operas of Gilbert and Sullivan. He was long associated with the English National Opera and Welsh National Opera and was the first Australian chief conductor of the Sydney Symphony Orchestra. He also specialized in Czech music as a whole, producing many recordings for the Czech label Supraphon. Charles Mackerras was a composers & musicians from Schenectady (1925-11-17, Schenectady–2010-07-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Charles Mackerras was a prominent conductor and musicologist who specialized in Czech music, producing many recordings for Supraphon. His work had a notable impact on the operatic scene in Australia and Europe.
